title_en: Design method of dynamic menu binding of workflow links in field of government affair
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method of dynamic menu binding of workflow links in the field of government affair, which comprises the following steps: in a current conventional application system of the government affair with workflow, according to service needs, carrying out association binding on links in the workflow through dynamic menu management, binding pending tasks in one or more flow links with menu items, and simultaneously combining a customized listing technology to customize corresponding table heads for each flow link or a plurality of flow links, thereby achieving perfect combination of the dynamic flow and menus. By binding the dynamic menus with the workflow links and binding different links with different menus, different tasks adopt appropriate service names, so a user of the system can accurately judge the specific application and purpose of the link. By configuring supports for the corresponding menu dynamic management and corresponding workflow engines, the method of the invention completes the dynamic allocation and setting of flow menus and completes the application requirements, so that the application system more conforms to the actual service logic.

title_en: Automated Purchase Assembly Conversion Process To Support A Dynamic Configure-To-Order Production Operation
abstract_en: A computer implemented method, a tangible computer usable medium, and a data processing system allocate materials to an automated purchase assembly conversion process to support a dynamic configure-to-order production operation. A configure-to-order backlog order is analyzed to determine demand for a particular purchase assembly. If the demand for the particular purchase assembly can be filled with an on-hand purchase assembly in inventory, the on-hand purchase assembly in inventory is allocated to fill the demand. If the demand for the particular purchase assembly can not be filled with an on-hand purchase assembly in inventory, a determination is made as to whether the demand for the particular purchase assembly can be filled by reallocating other similar on-hand purchase assembly in inventory and on-hand individual parts. If the demand for the particular purchase assembly can be filled by reallocating other on-hand purchase assembly in inventory and on-hand individual parts, the on-hand purchase assembly in inventory and the on-hand individual parts are reallocated to fill the demand.

title_en: Dynamic resource allocation in recover to cloud sandbox
abstract_en: A recover to cloud (R2C) service replicates a customer production environment to virtual data centers (VDCs) operated in a cloud service provider environment. Customers provision both a disaster recovery VDC and a test VDC. At A Time of Disaster (ATOD), the disaster VDC is made available to the customer through the cloud. The disaster VDC is allocated a first set of resources dedicated to the specific customer and to disaster recovery. The test VDC, brought on line at A Time of Test (ATOT), is allocated resources from second set of resources arranged in a shared pool. separate from the first set. Provisioning of the test VDC does not disturb critical resource assignments needed in the event of a disaster.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of intelligent city based on housing preference plan model dynamic microscopic simulation method, Monte Carlo technique is utilized to produce new house information, by resident according to family structure, classify in family income and job site, each class resident has similar selective factor B when selecting house, utilize maximum likelihood estimate to estimate the effective equation coefficient, utilize relative utility, t statistical value and the contribution degree of adjustable log-likelihood comparison model, degree of belief and the goodness of fit carry out detecting the analog capability with Optimized model, Microplanner model in conjunction with the discrete selection of multinomial index calculates value of utility and effectiveness probability, Monte Carlo technique is utilized to simulate housing preference, thus simulation and predicted city land use change survey, for urban construction, management and planning provide decision support.The present invention can provide decision support for urban land programmed decision-making person, it is possible to is estimated the adjustment feasibility of reallocation of land policy, is adapted to the demand of China's urban construction administration planning.

title_en: Electric vehicle distributed intelligence
abstract_en: To improve the management of a power grid.SOLUTION: A method for power tracking and power allocation comprises: receiving data, including selection of customers, to allow scheduling of charging start times, locations, and charging durations for charging to the EVs from a plurality of identified charging stations and electric vehicles (EVs) of customers at distributed locations throughout a power grid; receiving a plurality of system parameters and charging infrastructure parameters from assets of the power grid; and analyzing the data with respect to available power for those locations and customer historical usage and profiles. In the analysis, it may be better to determine, from the parameters, whether there is sufficient power availability within the power grid to support charging the EVs at locations of the charging stations within the power grid. It may also be better to send commands for power reallocation to assets of the power grid, based on the analysis.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Location Services in Mining Vehicle Operations
abstract_en: A system of computers, wireless networks, and vehicle-based location sensors allows real time display of equipment location, utilization, and expected arrival times for mobile vehicles. Display of location by load status and expected arrival time allows monitoring of not just vehicle location but the impact on queue times at loading and unloading endpoints allowing for equipment reallocation. Overhead map views of actual location including hazard locations and queries for vehicle and operator status are also supported.

title_en: Software-defined networking disaster recovery
abstract_en: Embodiments relate to software-defined networking (SDN) disaster recovery. An aspect is a system that includes an SDN controller configured to interface with a plurality of servers and switches in a network. The SDN controller includes processing circuitry configured to perform a method that includes establishing a plurality of flows, by the SDN controller, between a plurality of switches and pairs of servers in a network, including at least two different pairs of server types. Each server type runs a different operating system and a different disaster recovery manager in an active/active configuration. Data migration is controlled, by the SDN controller, between the pairs of servers in the network. The SDN controller dynamically reallocates the flows between the switches and the pairs of servers in the network based on detecting a fault in the network.

title_en: Automatic cloud-based disaster recovery system including modifying a copy command based on a copy time threshold
abstract_en: Restoration devices in a cloud storage system are paired with source containers associated with a mainframe computer, and series of commands are generated based on the pairings to cause copies of data at the source containers to be stored to the restoration devices. A point-in-time copy of the copy of the data at the source containers may be stored to some restoration devices, and a second copy of the data may be stored to other restoration devices. The restoration devices may be reallocated from inactive source containers. Execution of the commands is monitored, and the commands are modified if the execution of the commands does not satisfy one or more desired conditions. For example, a cycle time associated with copying data to a restoration device may be measured, and if the cycle time exceeds a threshold, the command may be modified.

title_en: Business plan method for supporting business plan management
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a business plan method for supporting business plan management, which may verify the feasibility of a management goal, and may establish a business plan for supporting business plan management that may enable a short or long term budget or business plan to be established in order to achieve a defined business goal. The business plan method performed by a system of supporting business plan management, the system including a business planning unit, comprises a business planning process of establishing a budget plan and a budget supply plan for establishing a business goal and achieving it, using basic business data including essential company information. To achieve the established business goal, the business plan method performs a simulation through making a budget and distributing the resources of the company, compares the simulation result to an execution result of an actual business plan, and re-plans a budget establishment and distribution plan, thereby efficiently working out the business plan that may efficiently achieve the business goal.

title_en: Software-definition survivable network construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a software-definition survivable network construction method. The method is mainly used to solve problems of poor survivability and long survivability recovery time in the prior art. The method is characterized in that through thinking of software definition network logic, forwarding separation and centralized management and control, firstly, a survivability controller is used to collect network topologies and reasonably program a network route; secondly, when the network is damaged, the survivability controller replans the network route according to a damaged node, a link and an area in real time so as to realize a network survivability ability. In the invention, two kinds of survivability recovery algorithms are provided. The two kinds of survivability recovery algorithms comprise shortest path recovery and fastest speed recovery. The shortest path recovery can guarantee that network end-to-end is a shortest path and the fastest speed recovery can guarantee that recovery time is shortest. Through using the method to establish the survival network, rapid survivability recovery can be realized and compatibility with a traditional network can be guaranteed. An application demand of a high network connectivity requirement under severe environments of natural disasters, military application and the like can be satisfied.

title_en: Tire inventory decision support system
abstract_en: A tire inventory decision support system (100) optimizes tire allocations across a plurality of trade areas for local tire dealers, as well as regional trade areas for tire repositories as regional fulfillment hubs. The system defines trade areas having demographic tire demand characteristics and corresponding to an available inventory population for respective dealers. For each trade area, optimal dealer inventory populations are projected for tire sizes and brands, based in part on the available inventory population for the dealer an actual inventory population for the associated tire repository. The system compares the optimal inventory population for each dealer to actual inventory population, and selectively generates dealer interfaces displaying recommendations for tire inventory modification based on value propositions as disparities between the optimal and actual inventory populations. The system may further identify value propositions for inventory reallocation by regional hubs themselves, based on aggregated inventory for associated dealers.

title_en: Information processing device, work distribution method and program
abstract_en: To easily allocate work of a person in charge of work with high load to a person in charge of work with low load.SOLUTION: A data acquisition unit 151 acquires attendance data 20 of each person in charge of work and work content data 30 indicating work contents. A worker classification unit 153 classifies, based on the attendance data 20, each person in charge of work on a specific day into an overtime worker and a non-overtime worker. A supportable person extraction unit 154 extracts a non-overtime worker whose low-priority work is included in the work contents as a supportable person. A reallocation processing unit 156 allocates work of the overtime workers to the supportable persons so that overtime hours of overtime workers are counterbalanced by work hours of low priority work of supportable persons. title_en: System and method for establishing disaster recovery execution plan of soc facilities

abstract_en: The present invention provides a system and a method for establishing an SOC facility damage recovery execution plan which can establish a recovery execution plan to quickly recover from damage to SOC facilities. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system for establishing an SOC facility damage recovery execution plan comprises: a damage facility and situation input unit to input SOC facilities damaged by a disaster and a damage situation; a damage recovery method selection unit to select a damage recovery method based on the inputted damage facilities and damage situation; a damage recovery execution plan establishing unit to allocate recovery resources and derive a damage recovery execution plan to perform the selected damage recovery method; an information transfer unit to request damage recovery aid from a mobile terminal loaded in the allocated recovery resources; a moving status determination unit to use current location information, acceleration information, angular velocity information, and direction information of recovery resources for which the damage recovery aid is requested to determine whether to move the recovery resources by the mobile terminal loaded in the allocated recovery resources; a reception checking unit to receive moving status determination information of the allocated recovery resources from the moving status determination unit; and a recovery resource change situation determination unit to use the moving status determination information of the recovery resources received by the reception checking unit to determine and decide whether to reallocate recovery resources and whether to change the derived damage recovery execution plan in the damage recovery execution plan establishing unit.

title_en: System and method for hierarchical metric temporal planning and re-planning
abstract_en: Advanced systems and methods for temporal planning employ a temporal logic for representing and reasoning about temporal constraints over both logic and numeric (discrete and continuous) variables and continuous time. A temporal planning language represents a world model, and adapts the temporal planning language to support formulas expressing the temporal logic. Embodiments of the present disclosure also can receive a temporal planning problem and derive one or more solutions to the temporal planning problem using one or more of the formulas. Embodiments of the present disclosure further address re-planning such as, for example, when a new objective task is added to the set of objective tasks to be performed, when an existing objective task is cancelled, and/or when some event occurs unpredictably and invalidates the current plan.

title_en: Aircraft stand recovery optimization
abstract_en: Systems and methods for allocating flights to aircraft stands are provided. In one example aspect, a system includes one or more computing devices. The computing devices are configured to generate a stand recovery plan that reallocates flights to available aircraft stands following a flight schedule disruption. Flights associated with an aircraft stand conflict can be reallocated to aircraft stands that are available within a determined time slot, by ensuring that the available aircraft stands meet one or more scheduling constraints or criteria, and based at least in part on a determined weighted total walk time. The weighted total walk time takes into account the estimated walk time between aircraft stands and/or their associated gates as well as the connecting time between flights. Once aircraft stands are reallocated to flights associated with the identified aircraft stand conflict(s), a stand recovery plan can be generated in real time.

title_en: Blockchain Framework for Enforcing Regulatory Compliance in Healthcare Cloud Solutions
abstract_en: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system comprising at least one processor and at least one memory, the at least one memory comprising instructions which are executed by the at least one processor and configure the processor to implement a healthcare blockchain framework for enforcing regulatory compliance in healthcare cloud solutions. The mechanism provides a healthcare blockchain framework to create, read, update, and delete elements of a healthcare compliance model supporting a dynamic allocation of cloud resources to a healthcare business network. Compliance with one or more healthcare regulations is built into the blockchain framework. Responsive to a cloud operations component within the healthcare blockchain framework attaching at least one evidence record to a compliance repository, the blockchain application stores the at least one evidence record in the compliance repository using chaincode within the healthcare blockchain framework. A compliance attestation component within the healthcare blockchain framework reviews the at least one evidence record using business rules to ensure compliance with the one or more healthcare regulations. The compliance attestation component stores a validation certification in the compliance repository responsive to the compliance attestation component approving the at least one evidence record based on the business rules.

title_en: Dynamic distribution method for regional multi-track traffic passenger flow under operation interruption condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional multi-mode rail transit passenger flow dynamic allocation method under an operation interruption condition, which comprises the following steps of firstly constructing a regional multi-mode rail transit timetable expansion network, secondly constructing a multi-mode rail transit network passenger flow allocation model, thirdly solving the multi-mode rail transit network passenger flow allocation model by utilizing station and interval numbers contained in an interruption interval, interruption accident duration and running measures which are used for maintaining operation after interruption under the operation interruption condition, and finally obtaining passenger flow allocation quantity of each OD (optical node) on passenger flow based on an effective path and corresponding indexes of the passenger flow. The model constructed by the invention can describe the actual situation distribution situation of passengers on each path, is compatible with various transportation modes based on the operation interruption condition, is beneficial to emergency collaborative management among multi-track traffic, can describe the real-time travel track and distribution situation of the passengers more accurately and effectively, and provides theoretical support and guidance for multi-track traffic emergency passenger flow distribution.

title_en: Remote disaster recovery method based on super-fusion cloud
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote disaster recovery method based on a super-fusion cloud, and relates to the technical field of distributed virtualization. The intelligent cloud management system comprises a center node and an edge node, wherein the center node and the edge node are connected through a multi-megaoptical network, a center physical machine, a super-fusion cloud management platform and an operation maintenance platform are arranged in the center node, and a node physical machine and the operation maintenance platform are arranged in the edge node. The method introduces a super fusion cloud technology, particularly a distributed storage and multi-copy technology of SDS, and realizes the resource fusion sharing of the central and edge node physical machines, and the virtual machines are migrated at high speed among different physical machines. When the edge nodes are more, the cost advantages of the technical scheme are more obvious, the invention virtualizes all the resources, the dynamic allocation of the resources among different nodes, such as calculation resources, network resources, storage resources and the like, can be realized, the problem of overlarge load of individual edge nodes can be well solved, and the safety of data is improved.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud test method for key equipment of the Internet of things in typical application of smart cities, wherein a test system of the cloud test method comprises a system foreground, a background management, an interface service and a data communication client, and the cloud test method specifically comprises the following steps: s1, client registration and business consultation; s2, selecting and matching service and submitting data; s3, confirming service and signing an agreement; s4, dispatching orders and pushing data; s5, receiving a sample and carrying out business test; s6, summarizing, archiving and sending reports. title_en: Air-ground robot task dynamic allocation method, storage medium and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic task allocation method for an air-ground robot, a storage medium and a terminal device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: laying out n air-ground robots for observing m task points and defining an observation description model of the air-ground robots, wherein the air-ground robots comprise air robots and ground robots, and n is larger than m; based on the observation description model of the air-ground robot, establishing a state model corresponding to the task point according to space-time characteristics, and acquiring a profit model when the air-ground robot executes the task point based on the state model; and establishing a two-stage heuristic task allocation strategy based on the income model to complete the dynamic task allocation of the air-ground robot. The air-ground robot task dynamic allocation method effectively quantifies the profit relationship between the air-ground robot and the tasks, and can overcome the profit calculation deviation brought by space-time parameters, thereby supporting the air-ground robot to efficiently complete the operation.

title_en: Urban rainwater resource utilization space-time dynamic allocation and transaction method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for spatial-temporal dynamic allocation and transaction of urban rainwater resource utilization, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a rainfall prediction model of a support vector machine, collecting data of an urban rainwater collection system, constructing an urban rainwater topology network model, and obtaining a rainfall-rainwater utilization incidence relation; and predicting rainfall data of the next period by adopting the rainfall prediction model of the support vector machine, inputting the obtained rainfall data of the next period into the urban rainwater topology network model to obtain a rainwater utilization parameter, and judging whether the rainwater utilization parameter reaches an expected value of rainwater transaction. The method provides a feasible scheme for space-time dynamic allocation, prediction and utilization of urban rainwater resources, improves the utilization efficiency of rainwater, and obtains good economic, social and environmental benefits.

title_en: Inventory sharing warehouse system and scoring and distributing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disc stock sharing warehouse system and a scoring and distributing method thereof. And the logical bin is used for logically splitting goods in a storage area of the physical bin. And the collection bin is used for collecting the associated logic bins. And the channel bin is in one-to-one correlation with the collection bin and is used for correlating the warehouses provided by the various online power provider platforms. To sum up, the above technical scheme has the following beneficial effects: the system establishes a five-layer warehouse structure model, realizes inventory sharing of each store or warehouse of an enterprise in an inventory gathering mode, and a inventory sharing warehouse scoring method is used for evaluating sales performance of each channel on a line. A disk inventory sharing warehouse allocation method supports a combination of a static allocation mechanism and a dynamic allocation mechanism.

title_en: Flood disaster emergency risk avoiding and material real-time allocation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent decision, in particular to an emergency risk avoiding and material real-time allocation method for flood disasters. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring original sampling data; constructing a flood simulation model; generating dynamic simulation process data of flood according to the flood simulation model; generating a maximum flood submerging water depth grid map according to the flood dynamic simulation process data; constructing a rapid and intelligent flood inundation prediction model according to the maximum flood inundation water depth grid map, and generating simulation process data of flood inundation; generating disaster-affected data according to the flooding simulation process data; generating danger-avoiding transfer real-time data and scheduling decision data according to the disaster-suffered data; constructing a material allocation model according to risk avoidance transfer real-time analysis and scheduling decision analysis, and generating material allocation real-time data and scheduling decision data according to the material allocation model; the method takes flood simulation, flood real-time prediction, risk avoiding transfer analysis and material allocation analysis as core technical processes to support flood emergency flood control decisions.

title_en: Aided decision-making method based on travel sightseeing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary decision-making method based on travel sightseeing, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining sightseeing information of scenic spots, obtaining scenic spot cultural scenic spot public praise index information, scenic spot tourist complaint amount information and scenic spot cultural scenic spot appreciation index information of the scenic spots, carrying out normalization processing on the scenic spot cultural scenic spot public praise index information, scenic spot tourist complaint amount information and scenic spot cultural scenic spot appreciation index information, and analyzing sightseeing indexes of the scenic spots. The invention comprehensively analyzes the sightseeing index of the scenic spot and the road condition index of the scenic spot, makes an auxiliary decision on tourism management in time, prompts tourists to re-plan own tourism plans, and then carries out negative feedback on the sightseeing index of the scenic spot and the road condition index of the scenic spot, so that responsible personnel in the scenic spot plan and adjust the sightseeing index of the scenic spot and the road condition index of the scenic spot, and can attract more tourists to travel, thereby leading the tourism industry to develop towards a better direction.
assignees: WEST YUNNAN UNIV OF APPLIED SCIENCES

title_en: Water operation plan support device, water operation plan support method, and water operation plan support method
abstract_en: To re-plan a water operation plan which suppresses a plan change range while considering lowering of residual salt concentration even when a mismatch occurs between the water operation plan and an achievement.SOLUTION: A water operation plan support device includes: a water operation planning unit which creates a water operation plan of a water supply facility on the basis of water demand prediction; a re-planning determination unit which calculates, by pondage prediction simulation for each distribution reservoir, water excess or deficiency in a distribution reservoir where constraint violation of pondage upper or lower limit occurs, and determines that re-planning of a water operation plan is necessary; a water accommodation distribution reservoir selection unit which calculates, for each of distribution reservoirs other than the distribution reservoir, water accommodation surplus capacity according to coordination of water receiving volume, and selects a distribution reservoir which performs water accommodation on the basis of residual salt concentration of each of the distribution reservoirs or the distribution reservoir when water accommodation is performed to the distribution reservoir from among each of distribution reservoirs having water accommodation surplus capacity being the excess or deficiency or more of the water in each of the distribution reservoirs; and a water operation plan correction unit which corrects a planning value of the water operation plan of the water supply facility so that an excess or deficient amount of water in the distribution reservoir is accommodated from the selected distribution reservoir.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Early warning method for intelligent navigation operation risk
abstract_en: Disclosed is an early warning method for an intelligent navigation operation risk, comprising: according to a ship area model, determining a safe navigation area; acquiring navigated sea region information and importing same into a radar plotting aid; according to the ship speed of the present ship, the heading of the present ship, water surface obstacle information, and underwater obstacle information, predicting coordinates of a point of encounter; and if, in a current route, the coordinates of the point of encounter are inside the range of the safe navigation area, re-planning the route. By means of establishing a quaternary ship area model, safe navigation boundaries of an intelligent ship are determined. Water surface information and underwater information are collected by using various devices to predict possible collision risks that will be encountered, promptly plan a new route, and change the heading and speed, so as to promptly avoid the risk of collisions. The collision risks of the intelligent ship are predicted in real time during navigation thereof, thereby improving the navigational safety of the intelligent ship.

title_en: Intelligent re-planning method for task track under abnormal state of deep space probe
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent re-planning method for a task track under an abnormal state of a deep space detector, and belongs to the technical field of space. The implementation method of the invention comprises the following steps: selecting and establishing a detector track transfer model according to task characteristics; establishing a task track transfer optimization model; the transfer fuel consumption is evaluated through the DE calling of the selected transfer model, and the design parameters of the transfer model with optimal transfer fuel consumption are obtained; training a support vector machine-Gaussian regression prediction model; the task orbit region of interest is identified through the support vector machine, so that the sampling efficiency is improved, a Gaussian regression model is trained based on sampling points of the task orbit region of interest, and the prediction precision of the Gaussian regression model is improved; and (3) evaluating the speed increment required by the transfer of the existing target in the database by adopting a support vector machine-Gaussian regression prediction model obtained through training, taking the speed increment smaller than the residual speed increment of the detector as a constraint, assisting in selecting a new target according to task requirements, and re-planning the track by using the established track transfer optimization model.

title_en: Method for dynamic resource allocation and resource risk analysis of pumped storage power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for carrying out dynamic resource allocation and resource risk analysis on a pumped storage power plant, which comprises the following steps: constructing a dynamic resource judgment matrix based on the full life cycle cost of the pumped storage power station, and constructing a dynamic resource weight matrix based on a Delphi method; obtaining a weighted judgment matrix according to the dynamic resource weight matrix; according to the weighting judgment matrix, positive ideal solution and negative ideal solution of dynamic resources of each pumped storage power station are obtained; based on the positive ideal solution and the negative ideal solution, calculating Euclidean distances between the target values and the ideal values; based on the Euclidean distance, performing risk assessment and dynamic resource allocation on a plurality of pumped storage power stations; therefore, the analysis and evaluation of the total cost elements of the whole life cycle of the pumped storage power station are realized, and a data support and risk management method is provided for the stable operation of the power station.
assignees: ENERGY STORAGE RES INSTITUTE SOUTHERN POWER GRID PEAKING FM POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Program control method supporting uploading of emergency task
abstract_en: The invention provides a program control method for supporting the uploading of emergency tasks, which is characterized in that a bidirectional static linked list is established in a buffer area of an on-board computing terminal to store program control data, when the on-board computing terminal receives uploading data, task units to be inserted in the uploading data are sequentially extracted for conflict recognition, and conflict resolution is carried out according to conflict resolution rules according to whether the task units to be inserted are emergency tasks or not. Under the condition that planning systems of a plurality of ground users can independently generate planning tasks and upload, conflict judgment and resolution of the uploading tasks are carried out on the satellite, sharing of satellite task resources is achieved, and using efficiency of the satellite is improved; and the constraint condition that the key software of the spacecraft should avoid using dynamic allocation memory can be satisfied, and the method has high reliability.

title_en: Unmanned bee colony task allocation method based on success expected probability
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned swarm task allocation method based on success expected probability, which comprises the steps of firstly, decomposing an unmanned swarm task into a plurality of serially connected formation tasks, wherein each formation task is cooperatively completed by a plurality of unmanned platforms in parallel; screening unmanned platform resources according to successful expected probability threshold constraint of formation tasks, and reducing task resource allocation search space; and finally, a heuristic exploration strategy is adopted to efficiently explore and optimize the task resource allocation scheme, and a suboptimal scheme meeting a success expected probability threshold is rapidly formed. The method does not take optimal task allocation as a target, but takes the task success expected probability as a drive, can support the real-time allocation of unmanned swarm tasks, prevent the excessive allocation of single formation task resources, effectively improve the task execution success rate and efficiency and reduce the risk and cost.
assignees: THE 28TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: WebRTC media stream gateway system and disaster recovery method based on SIP protocol
abstract_en: The invention provides a WebRTC media stream gateway system based on SIP protocol and a disaster recovery method, which monitor the status information of a media server; when the working state of the first media server is abnormal, recording the information of the first media server and sending the information to all signaling servers; and reallocating an available second media streaming server to the session description protocol SDP of the local terminal according to the information of the first media server to realize renegotiation with the SDP of the remote terminal and reestablish a media streaming channel. Compared with the prior art, disaster recovery occurs in the WebRTC media stream gateway, and any processing is not needed in the media stream service, so that all Web browser calls providing services on the node can still be used continuously after the WebRTC media stream gateway is abnormal.
assignees: SHENZHEN LAN YOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based subway station hall path planning coordinated control method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twin-based subway station hall path planning linkage control method and device and a computer program medium, wherein a digital twin technology is adopted to realize navigation of a passing path between a starting position and an end position under the support of a topological point of a subway station hall three-dimensional model, in the process, the navigation is adapted to scene change, configured topological points are updated for the linkage of a new scene, a minimum unit triangular surface topological point set circle is reconstructed under the support of the topological points, and the path is re-planned through the reconstructed minimum unit triangular surface topological point set circle, so that the user does not need to search the passing path by himself, and intelligent dynamic path planning is realized for the subway station hall.

title_en: Monitoring method and system for e-commerce warehouse inventory management
abstract_en: The invention provides a monitoring method and a system for warehouse inventory management of an e-commerce, which are applied to the field of warehouse inventory management; the invention can better grasp the inventory condition through real-time monitoring and inventory allocation, avoid the occurrence of stock overstock or insufficient inventory condition, realize the optimal management of the inventory, and simultaneously can improve the distribution efficiency, reduce the distribution cost, shorten the distribution time and improve the customer satisfaction degree by establishing the distribution strategy, implementing the logistics coordination and the real-time allocation, and can provide real-time data support and decision reference for a management layer and enhance the data driving management by utilizing the inventory management database and the cloud inventory content which is synchronously shared in real time.

title_en: Virtual cloud desktop resource management method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of cloud desktop resource management, and discloses a virtual cloud desktop resource management method, which comprises the following steps: step one, demand analysis and planning: a. determining specific requirements and targets of resource management; b. designing an overall planning and architecture of resource management, and introducing a complex algorithm to optimize resource allocation and decision; step two, system deployment and configuration: a. deploying a virtual cloud desktop system, and configuring a monitoring tool to collect system performance data and user behavior data; b. and setting security measures to ensure the system security and prepare a disaster recovery fault tolerance scheme. By introducing a complex algorithm and dynamic resource allocation, the system can effectively manage resources, avoid resource waste, improve resource utilization rate, establish a user experience evaluation model and a deep learning algorithm, and predict user satisfaction, so as to optimize user experience, security reinforcement measures and vulnerability management system, and reduce the risk of the system being threatened by security.
assignees: SHANGHAI HAOLAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent systems, in particular to an intelligent system based on big data. The intelligent event analysis system comprises a data fusion module, an intelligent event analysis module, a human resource library module, an optimal scheduling module, a dynamic allocation guide module and an interactive command control module, wherein the data are deeply analyzed by utilizing machine learning and pattern recognition technology to recognize safety events and abnormal behaviors through collecting and fusing multi-source data, and the events are automatically classified and marked. And (3) recording manpower distribution and response records by establishing a human resource database, and calculating an optimal police dispatch scheme by adopting a constraint optimization algorithm according to the event priority and the geographic position. The dynamic allocation guide module adjusts the manpower allocation in real time. The invention not only improves the working efficiency and the reaction speed, but also optimizes the resource allocation, enhances the flexibility of dynamic allocation and enhances the decision support capability of related personnel through the cooperative work of a plurality of modules.

title_en: Decentralized multi-unit collaboration convenience problem processing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information technology and intelligent service, in particular to a decentralized multi-unit cooperation convenience problem processing system, which comprises a user reporting interface module, an intelligent task distribution module, a multi-unit cooperation module, a decentralized processing module, a problem circulation and redistribution module and a real-time feedback and notification module, wherein the user reporting interface module is used for receiving a user report from a user; the user reporting interface module allows the user to select the problem type; the intelligent task allocation module allocates tasks to corresponding areas and units; the multi-unit collaboration module matches the problem to a plurality of units; the decentralizing processing module supports parallel processing of a plurality of units; the problem circulation and redistribution module automatically redistributes the problems; the real-time feedback and notification module realizes a real-time feedback mechanism for problem processing. According to the invention, task allocation is carried out according to the problem type and the position information, and a reallocation program is triggered when the problem is not processed in time.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle power inspection scene-oriented node fault dynamic recovery method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a node fault dynamic recovery method and device for an unmanned aerial vehicle power inspection scene and a storage medium, and relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle power inspection task distribution. Firstly, acquiring task pre-allocation target information in an unmanned aerial vehicle power inspection scene, and constructing a task pre-allocation matrix; then based on the obtained task pre-allocation target information, acquiring and identifying the node state of the unmanned aerial vehicle/machine nest in real time, and confirming the dynamic recovery re-allocation task scene; and (3) establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle power inspection task redistribution optimization model, and solving a task redistribution problem by using a random sequence auction algorithm considering task loads to obtain an optimal dynamic recovery result. The node fault dynamic recovery method disclosed by the invention can reflect the current task load of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time, provide a basis for dynamic adjustment task allocation, and can rapidly give an accurate and reliable task reallocation scheme under the condition of node faults, thereby ensuring continuous operation of a system and timely completion of tasks.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECH CO;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Education learning system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to an educational learning system based on big data, which relates to the field of educational learning, and comprises: the prediction execution device is arranged at the big data server and is used for predicting the number of open class students, the number of student questions and the accumulated number of question duration in the on-line education course development period based on a plurality of educational course data corresponding to the on-line education courses of a set teacher and each piece of configuration information of the preset department developed on the line of the set teacher; and the resource allocation equipment is used for determining the teaching aid quantity required to be configured for the online education course based on the prediction result. According to the invention, each item of education learning data of the online education course to be developed can be predicted by the big data server according to each item of basic data by using the artificial intelligent model, and the dynamic allocation of online education learning resources is executed based on the prediction result, so that the effect of online teaching is ensured while the waste of resources is avoided.

title_en: Virtual server state monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring a state of a virtual server, and relates to the technical field of virtual servers. The system comprises: a monitoring module configured to monitor performance and monitor availability data; the intelligent manufacturing business continuity module is used for monitoring transactions and recovering faults and responding to instructions and information from the disaster recovery module, the intrusion prevention module and the alarm notification module; the disaster recovery module is used for backing up and recovering data, synchronizing across data centers and responding to instructions and information from the intelligent manufacturing business continuity module and the alarm notification module; the intrusion prevention module is used for protecting the server and responding to the instruction and the information from the monitoring module and the alarm notification module; and the dynamic resource allocation module is used for optimizing the resource utilization of the server and responding to the instruction and the information from the monitoring module and the alarm notification module. The system and the method can comprehensively monitor the performance, availability, service continuity and safety of the server.

title_en: Production resource dynamic allocation management method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a production resource dynamic allocation management method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method not only fully utilizes priori knowledge to accelerate and optimize the learning process of the machine learning model, but also captures the time sequence characteristics in the service operation data through the long-term and short-term memory network, thereby realizing the accurate calculation and dynamic updating of the production resource scheduling view. The method remarkably improves the accuracy and efficiency of production scheduling of the LNG receiving station, and provides powerful support for operation management of the receiving station.

title_en: Full-dimension battlefield situation information presentation device and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information presentation, in particular to a full-dimension battlefield situation information presentation device and terminal equipment, the device comprises a data time sequence synchronization module, a key information extraction module, an abnormal mode monitoring module, an information priority adjustment module, a resource dynamic allocation module and a presentation interface adjustment module. According to the invention, through synchronizing multisource battlefield data and accurate time marks in real time, time consistency of all information is ensured, abnormal modes are monitored, classification marks are carried out, the identification effect on unstable factors is improved, the information priority is dynamically adjusted, so that key information is displayed preferentially, the timeliness of decision support is ensured, efficient utilization of computing resources is ensured through dynamic resource allocation, response time is reduced, operation efficiency is optimized, display parameters are regulated through external environment illumination, the readability of interfaces and the understandability of information are improved, and the efficiency and effect of battlefield information presentation are optimized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle network system and method for communication recovery of unmanned area or disaster area
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle network communication and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle network system and a method for recovering communication in an unmanned area or a disaster area, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out geographic information analysis on the unmanned area or the disaster area to obtain an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment scheme and a self-adaptive network routing model; the method comprises the steps of controlling a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles equipped with satellite communication equipment to establish an initial communication network with a communication satellite network, carrying out ad hoc network on the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles to obtain a mesh network among the unmanned aerial vehicles, throwing multi-frequency band network signals to a portable ground station and an emergency communication terminal to generate a ground coverage network, carrying out high-speed data forwarding path optimization on the ground coverage network to obtain a target data transmission path, and carrying out unmanned aerial vehicle rotation planning and dynamic resource allocation based on the target data transmission path to obtain a final high-coverage communication network, so that quick, efficient and durable communication recovery is realized.

title_en: Electronic contest place intelligent store management system based on cloud computing power
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of store management, and discloses an intelligent store management system for an electronic contest place based on cloud computing power. Through AI emotion recognition and performance adjustment, the system can provide more individualized service, adjust the computer performance according to customer's emotional state, promote game experience, cloud computing power dispatch module can be according to the optimal utilization of place demand dynamic allocation cloud resource, realize the resource, reduce the energy consumption, improve system stability, intelligent security module can 24 hours control electronic contest place, in time discover abnormal situation and report to the police, ensure the security in place, the system can provide thorough business data analysis, help the manager to know customer consumption habit and commodity heat, provide support for marketing decision, promote business growth, provide differentiated service and individualized experience, make electronic contest place can attract the customer better, strengthen market competitiveness.
assignees: ZHUHAI XINWANGBO INFORMATION SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for realizing dynamic fusion type disaster recovery mode
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for realizing a dynamic fusion type disaster recovery mode. The system is characterized by comprising a service positioning module, a service processing module and a signaling processing module. The invention utilizes the service route forwarding capability of the service positioning module to realize the routing selection of the SIP call from the external IMS signaling network to the service network element by the service positioning module after the processing of the signaling processing module and the service processing module, and utilizes the dynamic service configuration, the service network element state monitoring and the service volume dynamic allocation algorithm in the service positioning module to realize the dynamic switching capability of various disaster recovery modes such as the main and standby modes, the load sharing mode, the warm standby mode and the like from the capability network element to the service network element.

title_en: Education and teaching resource dynamic allocation management system and method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for dynamically distributing and managing educational and teaching resources based on machine learning, which relate to the field of resource distribution and management, and the invention obtains feature classification center data capable of reflecting each educational and teaching resource and each educational and teaching resource demander by clustering a current resource feature data set matrix and a current demander feature data set matrix, thereby providing data support for matching the educational and teaching resources with the educational and teaching resource demander subsequently; and if the quantity of the best student score grade data meeting the requirement does not meet the requirement, the clustering center data obtained by the clustering operation is optimized again, so that most types of education and teaching resource demanders can be matched with the most suitable education and teaching resource types.

title_en: Method and system for allocating manpower resources for one-hospital multi-region logistics
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for allocating manpower resources of one-hospital multi-region logistics, which utilize by constructing a hospital logistics scene knowledge graph and an allocation demand template The language understanding capability and the multi-mode information processing capability of the system realize intelligent analysis of human resource allocation requirements and constraint conditions under different service scenes, and a set of dynamic resource allocation mechanism is designed by combining a multi-objective optimization algorithm, so that an optimal human resource allocation scheme meeting the requirements of multi-area cooperation and dynamic service can be adaptively generated. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the method can remarkably improve the intelligent level and management efficiency of the hospital logistics human resource allocation, and provides powerful support for multi-region high-quality operation of a hospital.

title_en: Outdoor life guaranteeing method and system capable of realizing modularized grouping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a field life guaranteeing method and system capable of realizing modularized grouping, and relates to the technical field of resource management, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting operation and environmental adaptability data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a vehicle configuration optimization model to realize the optimal configuration of resources, designing and managing field life support system resources according to a dynamic resource allocation model, adapting to environmental changes based on an environmental adaptability model, and considering the automatic horizontal output deployment time of vehicles. According to the modularized grouping field life support method, the optimal configuration of resources is realized by constructing the vehicle configuration optimization model, the task execution efficiency is improved, the field life support system resources are designed and managed according to the dynamic resource allocation model, the response capacity and efficiency of the system are improved, the environment change is adapted based on the environment adaptability model, the reliability and stability of the system are enhanced, and the modularized grouping field life support method has better effects in the aspects of resource utilization rate, efficiency and safety.
assignees: SUZHOU JIANGNAN AEROSPACE MECH & ELECTRICAL INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Large road network multi-vehicle path load balancing method based on reinforcement learning graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a large road network multi-vehicle path load balancing method based on a reinforcement learning graph neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining road network data in a real scene, modeling the road network, representing the road network as a graph structure, splitting the graph structure into a plurality of sub-graph structures, wherein each sub-graph structure corresponds to one sub-road network, constructing and training the reinforcement learning self-adaptive graph neural network, calling the trained reinforcement learning self-adaptive graph neural network to generate corresponding road selection probability for each sub-road network of the road network in parallel, merging the generated sub-road selection probabilities according to the topological structure of an original road network, recovering the road selection probability into each road selection probability in the original road network, and realizing road load balancing based on each road selection probability in the original road network. The invention realizes efficient path re-planning in a large-scale road network scene, reduces road network load in real time, solves the problem of road congestion, and improves traffic efficiency.

title_en: Self-organizing sensing and control migration system and method under abnormal event of industrial park
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-organizing perception and control migration system and a self-organizing perception and control migration method under an industrial park abnormal event, wherein the system comprises a prevention stage, a response stage and a recovery stage, the system further comprises an abnormal event model, an intelligent energy unit and a toughness optimization model, wherein the abnormal event model consists of a natural disaster abnormal event and a fault abnormal event, the intelligent energy unit regulates perception and control of edge nodes through a load cluster under the abnormal event, the toughness optimization model regulates the optimization process of each stage through a plurality of decisions, and the system can accurately capture the industrial park abnormal signal, flexibly regulate the production flow, reallocate resources and improve the toughness and reliability of the industrial park.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Physicochemical experiment AI teaching aid for adaptive learning path planning and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physicochemical experiment AI teaching aid for adaptive learning path planning and a realization method thereof, wherein after planning a first learning path for students, hand tracking data of the students are analyzed in the experimental process, and the learning path is re-planned after scoring data is obtained, so that the analysis can be carried out according to the self condition of the students and the operation performance in the experiment, the adaptability of subsequent experiments on the experimental quality of the students is changed, the students can be ensured to obtain the experimental guidance conforming to the students, and the defect that the prior art cannot carry out the targeted experimental guidance according to the students is overcome; the first learning path is used for respectively adjusting preset standard values of each experiment of the students, the preset standard values are positively correlated with the learning achievements, the learning ability of the students is matched by adjusting the preset standard values, and the teaching strategy can be dynamically adjusted according to the learning progress and the achievements of the students so as to adapt to the continuously-changing learning demands of the students.
assignees: JIANGSU TAIKEQUAN INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency facility site selection and service optimization model under facility failure and traffic jam conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency facility site selection and service optimization model under the condition of facility failure and traffic jam, which relates to the technical field of comprehensive facility site selection, wherein a pre-disaster planning decision model F  1  is used for site selection decision of an emergency shelter and multi-stage service allocation decision with priority, a dynamic optimization model F  2  under the condition of failure of the post-disaster emergency shelter is used for reallocating services between temporary rescue points and the shelter and route adjustment of self-evacuation crowd under the condition of user balance UE, and a double-layer mixed integer nonlinear planning model MINLP based on a priority service allocation relation is formed by the pre-disaster planning decision model F  1  and a dynamic optimization model F  2  under the condition of failure of the post-disaster emergency shelter, and an equivalent single-layer mixed integer nonlinear planning model is deduced according to KKT conditions, wherein the single-layer mixed integer nonlinear planning model comprises a necessary condition and a sufficient condition that the flow value of a UE road section in the dynamic optimization model F  2  under the condition of failure of the post-disaster emergency shelter.

title_en: Commodity inventory management method and system based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of inventory management and cloud computing application, in particular to a commodity inventory management method and system based on cloud computing, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting commodity dynamic information, environment state data and commodity state data and generating enhancement data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic scene graph, simulating resource flow through a distributed simulation system, generating scene prediction data by combining a quantum heuristic optimization algorithm, constructing a layered inventory structure based on the prediction data, realizing resource dynamic allocation among inventory layers through a multi-agent cooperative optimization algorithm, generating inventory optimization data, recording a resource allocation task execution process, and generating transparent inventory state data by utilizing a blockchain technology. The invention can dynamically adjust the inventory structure in real time, improve the inventory management precision, effectively reduce the inventory backlog and the risk of stock interruption and provide accurate support for supply chain management.

title_en: Intelligent park platform planning and designing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a platform planning and designing system for an intelligent park, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent city construction. According to the invention, multisource static and dynamic data are integrated through the data acquisition and integration module, the space function planning module and the dynamic resource allocation optimization module are used for constructing an optimization model based on core function requirements and resource requirements, scientific planning of space layout and resource allocation is realized, the simulation evaluation display module is used for dynamically evaluating traffic flow, environmental influence and resource efficiency by using a three-dimensional digital park model and a multidimensional simulation technology, visual and quantitative evaluation results are provided for a planning scheme, design risks are effectively reduced, the intelligent planning aid decision module and the user participation feedback module are combined, an optimal design strategy is recommended for cost, efficiency, environment and other dimensions through the rule engine and the multidimensional comparison model, and meanwhile, user requirements are collected and converted into optimization suggestions, so that a closed-loop optimization flow is formed, and the applicability and user satisfaction of the planning scheme are improved.

title_en: Virtual power plant energy storage management allocation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage management allocation system and method of a virtual power plant, wherein the energy storage management allocation system comprises a data acquisition module, a communication module, a central control unit and an allocation instruction generation module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data of distributed energy storage resources in the virtual power plant in real time, the communication module is connected with the data acquisition module and is used for transmitting the operation data to the central control unit and realizing information interaction among different main bodies, the central control unit is connected with the communication module and internally provided with a resource coordination system for receiving the operation data, the distributed energy storage resources are subjected to grouping management according to a preset rule and allocation instructions are generated according to the operation requirements of the virtual power plant, and the allocation instruction generation module is used for actively matching with a point exchange and benefit sharing promotion body through the built-in accurate resource coordination system according to multi-dimensional factor grouping management, priority ordering and dynamic allocation, so that the operation efficiency is greatly improved, and the capacity of an active support power grid is enhanced.

title_en: New energy permeability threshold-based self-adaptive allocation method for carbon emission responsibility of electric power system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy power systems, discloses a self-adaptive allocation method of carbon emission responsibility of a power system based on a new energy permeability threshold, and provides a dynamic responsibility allocation strategy aiming at the problem that the traditional carbon emission responsibility allocation mechanism is difficult to adapt to new energy volatility and permeability change; firstly, constructing a source-load collaborative carbon emission simulation model, defining a new energy permeability threshold and a hysteresis interval, dynamically switching three modes based on a permeability real-time value, namely a power generation side full-responsibility mode, a source-load benchmark allocation mechanism and a transition interval, and secondly, constructing a multi-objective optimization model, and collaborative optimizing fairness, new energy consumption and economy. The method can reduce the carbon emission responsibility distribution deviation, improve the new energy consumption rate and reduce the system operation cost, and provides technical support for the accurate carbon responsibility distribution of the high-proportion new energy power grid.

title_en: Dangerous goods warehouse risk management method and device based on sensing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a dangerous goods warehouse risk management method and device based on sensing equipment, which relate to the technical field of warehouse risk management and specifically comprise the following steps: dividing a warehouse into a plurality of independent areas, collecting the data of the volume, the temperature and the dust concentration of the aluminum powder stored in each area in the past and in the current time period, constructing a state vector, constructing an area assessment model based on a reinforcement learning model, acquiring a risk assessment coefficient of each area in the current time period, acquiring a proper coefficient of the aluminum powder stored in each area according to the volume, the temperature and the dust concentration of the aluminum powder stored in each area, carrying out weighted calculation on the risk assessment coefficient and the proper coefficient of each area, generating a priority coefficient of each area, and determining the priority of the newly purchased aluminum powder storage area according to the priority coefficient. The invention can effectively cope with the change of warehouse environment and the warehouse-in condition of new aluminum powder batch, and realize the safe and efficient management of the dynamic allocation of warehouse storage areas and provide powerful support.
assignees: ANHUI XIANGYUAN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster detection task planning method, device and equipment based on unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task allocation and optimization method, a system and a device based on a hierarchical task network, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating an unmanned aerial vehicle task set by using expert knowledge, and initializing task allocation parameters; then carrying out task level decomposition, establishing task allocation initial solution, formulating a subtask set to be executed for each unmanned aerial vehicle, establishing task constraint and optimization targets, solving task planning problems by adopting an improved genetic algorithm, and finally obtaining a conflict-free task sequence by a conflict resolution and re-planning algorithm. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster system, a ground station communication module, a central processing unit and a task planning solving module. The device stores an expert knowledge base and pre-execution instructions for realizing unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task execution. By using the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster can efficiently execute the appointed task set as required. The invention can be widely applied to disaster relief fields such as the field and urban areas.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster-based power line collaborative inspection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power line collaborative inspection system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, which relates to the technical field of power correlation and comprises a hypergraph topology modeling module, a fractal region dividing module, a dynamic task allocation module and an autonomous fault tolerance recovery module, wherein the hypergraph topology modeling module is used for constructing a hypergraph model of a power line and extracting a hypergraph topology feature matrix, the fractal region dividing module is used for dividing a region to be inspected into a plurality of subareas under the condition that space coverage equalization and boundary complexity are minimized under the constraint condition, the dynamic task allocation module is used for constructing an adaptation matrix, realizing optimal matching of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the adaptation matrix and carrying out power line collaborative inspection according to an optimal matching result, and the autonomous fault tolerance recovery module is used for carrying out task reallocation when faults occur during power line collaborative inspection. Through hypergraph modeling, regional division algorithm and self-adaptive task matching, accurate modeling of power system structures and risk factors, efficient division of inspection areas and intelligent scheduling of unmanned aerial vehicle resources are achieved, and efficiency and resource utilization rate of power line inspection are improved.

title_en: Comprehensive management system for security engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk analysis, in particular to a comprehensive management system of security engineering. According to the method, the lithology data are extracted through a drilling section to calculate the layer thickness mutation rate and the intensity attenuation rate, the lithology abnormal region is located by a variation coefficient, lithology mutation marks are analyzed through spatial clustering, a sliding window average value is compared and captures a dynamic trend, a digital elevation model is used for calculating gradient amplitude variation and slope dispersion, abnormal point density is fused to generate a topographic instability index, a multidimensional quantitative evaluation frame is established, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is performed to cross-verify the instability index and the engineering parameter trend, dynamic priority ranking is generated, a pile number interval is matched to construct a risk measure table, a hierarchical analysis method dynamic resource allocation support drainage scheme is monitored and predicted in real time, and a management and control strategy is adjusted in a self-adaptive mode.

title_en: Network line disaster recovery method and device under multi-service scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster recovery method and device for network line call under a multi-service scene, which solve the problem that in the prior art, when a service line fails, automatic switching of the service line cannot be realized, so that the user experience effect is poor. And simultaneously, when the line fails or the success rate of the http request in the line is lower than a preset value, a new line is re-planned to be generated, and the current line is switched into a new circuit, so that the automatic switching of the service line is realized, and the user experience is improved.
assignees: BAOFU NETWORK TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Emergency material dispatching system and material dispatching method based on ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency material scheduling system and method based on an ant colony algorithm. A demand prediction module of the emergency material intelligent scheduling system utilizes a space-time diagram neural network to dynamically predict material demands and constructs a layered network model integrating multi-mode transportation of unmanned aerial vehicles, ground vehicles and the like. The optimization calculation module adopts an improved ant colony algorithm, introduces a demand urgency weight factor and a green weight factor to construct a multi-objective fitness function, and combines a dynamic pheromone updating mechanism and a multi-ant colony cooperative strategy to optimize a transportation path. The system is provided with a dynamic adjustment module driven by edge calculation to realize 30-second-level rapid path re-planning, creatively integrates a psychological aid priority model, and extracts a psychological crisis index optimization scheduling strategy through emotion analysis. The invention effectively solves the problems of lag response and insufficient multi-objective optimization of the traditional dispatching system, remarkably improves the transportation efficiency by 25% -35%, reduces carbon emission and ensures the high efficiency, fairness and humanity care of emergency dispatching.

title_en: Hydropower plant automatic debugging system with self-adaptive communication function
abstract_en: The automatic debugging system for the hydropower plant with the self-adaptive communication function comprises a processing unit, a storage unit, a communication module, an input/output interface, task classification, model architecture configuration and other functional modules. The method comprises the steps of analyzing task complexity and high-dimensional characteristics of input data through a task classification module, classifying by adopting algorithms such as principal component analysis and a support vector machine, matching a model framework according to the complexity level by a model framework configuration module and determining an initial calculation path, optimizing the calculation path by combining real-time data by a dynamic path adjustment module, reallocating resources when calculation force exceeds limit by a resource allocation module, generating a compression model adapting to edge equipment by a model compression module through pruning and quantization algorithms, and jointly optimizing model parameters by a parameter fine adjustment module aiming at a multi-task scene.

title_en: Orange ecological orchard data management platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data management platform for an orchard, which relates to the technical field of agricultural informatization and intelligent management, is used for solving the problem that decision efficiency is influenced by data delay, realizes real-time acquisition and classified storage of the data of the orchard environment by arranging a sensor node network and a distributed storage system, reduces the data redundancy and improves the analysis efficiency by data preprocessing and feature extraction, provides a scientific basis for resource allocation by utilizing a time sequence analysis algorithm to predict the change trend of the orchard environment, realizes the generation of a dynamic resource allocation scheme by introducing a self-adaptive weight allocation mechanism and a resource priority index, and supports users to check the data and adjust the resource allocation in real time by deploying an interaction module at the orchard management terminal so as to improve the intelligent level of the orchard management.

title_en: Enterprise intelligent management system and method based on multistage architecture
