abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise intelligent management system and method based on a multistage architecture, comprising a company-level strategic module, a department-level execution module, a personal-level task module, and a convolution algorithm engine and a low-code development platform which are connected with each level, wherein the convolution algorithm engine realizes dynamic allocation and optimization of cost data through the multistage convolution kernel model, the flattening architecture greatly shortens an information transmission path, improves the information transmission speed by more than 40%, enables enterprises to rapidly respond to market changes, improves the cost accounting precision by 30%, improves the resource utilization rate by 25%, reduces resource waste, improves the economic benefit of the enterprises, effectively reduces the inter-department communication time by 50%, breaks department barriers, improves the overall operation efficiency of the enterprises, and enables a real-time billboard to support second-level updating and early warning of enterprise key indexes (KPIs), so that the enterprises can grasp operation conditions in time, discover and solve problems in advance.
assignees: SHANGHAI ABUP INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle inspection task re-planning method under aircraft nest fault
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle routing task rescheduling method under a machine nest fault, which comprises the steps of obtaining a fault machine nest number, all remaining task point coordinates, a standby machine nest coordinate and remaining routing path data of each routing unmanned aerial vehicle, setting a routing unmanned aerial vehicle landing point corresponding to the fault machine nest as a device descending machine nest, establishing and solving a single-unmanned-vehicle routing task rescheduling model under a fixed starting point to reschedule a routing path corresponding to the routing unmanned aerial vehicle of the fault machine nest, establishing a multi-unmanned-vehicle task rescheduling model, designing and improving a self-adaptive large-scale neighborhood search algorithm, and solving the multi-unmanned-aerial-vehicle task rescheduling model to obtain a task rescheduling path with shortest routing time. The invention can efficiently solve the problem of re-planning of the tasks of the multiple unmanned aerial vehicles when the abnormal state of the machine nest fault occurs at any moment, so that the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle inspection system can continuously and stably conduct autonomous operation when encountering the sudden abnormal state of the machine nest fault, and the disaster recovery capability of the unmanned inspection system is remarkably improved.

title_en: AI- AND IoT-DRIVEN REAL-TIME CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract_en: An AI-and IoT-driven real-time construction management system continuously acquires and analyzes high-frequency sensor data, including temperature, GPS, and RFID inputs. Utilizing advanced predictive machine learning and reinforcement learning algorithms, the system forecasts schedule deviations and resource conflicts with an accuracy exceeding 90%. Upon identifying deviations, it autonomously triggers corrective actions—such as reallocating resources or adjusting task sequences—typically within five seconds. This integrated, closed-loop management approach seamlessly interfaces with external project management tools, achieving approximately 15-20% improved schedule adherence and notable cost reductions based on preliminary data. The system's modular architecture supports diverse sensor technologies and AI frameworks, ensuring adaptability and sustained performance in large-scale, dynamic construction environments.

title_en: Airport security check queuing number prediction method based on KAN and K-means clustering method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airport security check queuing number prediction method based on KAN and K-means clustering method, which relates to the field of airport security check queuing number prediction and comprises the steps of constructing multi-feature data and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing sample data, carrying out prediction on the preprocessed sample data through a KAN regression model, dividing normal and abnormal data sets, training a KAN classification model to obtain a classifier, clustering the normal and abnormal data sets, respectively training and testing each clustered cluster through a plurality of models, reserving a model with the best prediction effect, classifying the prediction data through the classifier, further determining a cluster center with the highest similarity of the prediction data, and carrying out prediction through a corresponding prediction model to obtain a final security check queuing number prediction result. The method not only effectively improves the prediction precision of the number of security check queuing people, but also provides important technical support for intelligent operation and maintenance of airports, personnel scheduling optimization and dynamic resource allocation, and has remarkable social benefit and economic value.

title_en: Distributed intelligent warehouse scheduling system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed intelligent warehouse scheduling system based on artificial intelligence, which belongs to the technical field of warehouse scheduling and comprises a multi-source environment sensing module, a dynamic inventory management module, a distributed task scheduling module, an intelligent path planning module, a resource dynamic allocation module, an anomaly detection and emergency response module, an energy consumption optimization module, a supply chain collaboration module and a man-machine interaction and visualization module, the warehouse digital twin model is constructed, the immersive display of the warehouse state and the scheduling strategy is realized, AR scenes are overlapped through color coding paths, thermodynamic diagrams and particle flow patterns, management staff can intuitively grasp inventory distribution, task progress and abnormal areas, the eye tracking and gesture recognition technology supports interactive decision making, the AR labeling function can mark the abnormal areas and synchronize to a decision making system, and a brand new interactive paradigm is provided for intellectualization and humanization of warehouse management through combination of AR and AI.
assignees: SUZHOU SHUHONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric vehicle charging scheduling double-target optimization method based on excitation game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-target optimization method for electric vehicle charging dispatching based on excitation game, which relates to the technical field of electric vehicle charging dispatching and comprises the following steps: and S100, constructing a dynamic response identification model of the user behavior, acquiring historical charging behavior data and excitation trigger time nodes, extracting response changes of the user under different excitation conditions, and generating response feature vectors. The method realizes dynamic allocation and differentiated scheduling of excitation resources by constructing user response feature vectors and response hierarchy division, introduces behavior feedback and load data to construct a response feedback matrix, supports strategy effect evaluation and self-adaptive optimization, forms a closed-loop control mechanism of recognition, guidance, feedback and correction, improves excitation response efficiency, power grid scheduling adaptability and system intelligence level, and effectively ensures power grid operation safety and user charging utility.
assignees: JIANGYIN FUREN HI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent building energy-saving optimization platform and method based on carbon footprint tracking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building energy-saving optimization platform and method based on carbon footprint tracking, and relates to the technical field of building energy conservation and carbon emission management. The method is used for solving the problems of extensive carbon emission evaluation, rigid quota allocation and insufficient energy-carbon coordination. And constructing a three-dimensional carbon density map by collecting people flow, equipment energy consumption and environmental data in real time, and dynamically identifying carbon row hot spots. And analyzing the association between the power grid and the renewable energy source through a carbon flow tracking model, and correcting the weight output contribution matrix. And (3) building carbon row gene entropy by combining the characteristics of equipment energy efficiency, building material hidden carbon rows and the like, generating a quota migration strategy by combining a game algorithm, and promoting the directional transfer of high carbon to a low carbon building. And a double-ring collaborative framework is constructed, starting and stopping of the inner-ring chaotic search optimizing equipment are performed to inhibit carbon density fluctuation, energy storage scheduling is adjusted through outer-ring carbon price mapping, accurate carbon emission tracing, quota dynamic allocation and carbon depth collaboration are realized, low-carbon transformation of a building is supported, and carbon emission reduction efficiency of a building cluster is improved.
assignees: DEJIEMENG PLANNING AND DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Storm surge set numerical forecasting method and device for parallel computing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of storm forecast, and discloses a storm surge set numerical forecasting method and device for parallel calculation, which are used for improving the efficiency, accuracy and robustness of storm surge set numerical forecasting. According to a dynamic resource allocation strategy, computing nodes are migrated in real time according to historical variance priority signals, computing resource utilization is optimized, a double-pipeline scheduling mechanism is constructed, prediction and correction tasks are alternately executed, pipeline waiting is eliminated by combining hardware-level synchronous signals, random disturbance field generation is accelerated by utilizing an FPGA coprocessor, physical rationality of a disturbance field is ensured, entropy value comparer is introduced to detect abnormal data in real time, computing is quickly restored through a process thermal migration technology, high-precision storm tidal water level field time sequence is generated by combining an MPI parallel frame, and a prediction result is output. The method realizes the high efficiency, accuracy and robustness of storm surge prediction through technical innovation, and provides powerful technical support for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Teaching big data resource management system based on cloud database
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of big data and discloses a teaching big data resource management system based on a cloud database, which integrates a data preparation unit, a cloud base unit and an intelligent central unit through a layered distributed architecture, builds a closed-loop service system, relies on the elastic energy storage capacity of the cloud database, senses the teaching scene load in real time through an elastic scheduling module, dynamically adjusts the computing resources and the storage space of the database by utilizing a storage resource expansion model and a resource dynamic allocation function, realizes automatic expansion in a high-load period and accurate contraction in a low-load period, avoids the performance bottleneck and resource idle problem of the traditional scheme, simultaneously ensures the data safety through cross-region synchronization, encryption storage and disaster recovery backup, combines knowledge maps and machine learning to realize intelligent analysis and recommendation of the teaching big data, provides elastic and efficient cloud database service and big data resource service management capacity for the teaching scene, and improves the resource utilization efficiency and the teaching service quality.
assignees: DALIAN ZAODAO YOUTU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid material vehicle path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid material vehicle path planning method, which provides a space-time layered modeling and cloud edge collaborative optimization framework aiming at the problems of dynamic forbidden operation, channel capacity fluctuation, multi-resource conflict, response lag and the like faced by power grid material scheduling in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of constructing a space-time coupled channel capacity-path planning layering model, pre-calculating a multi-commodity network flow, dynamically decoupling a real-time vehicle path, optimizing material distribution by combining a space-time double-coding genetic algorithm, designing a multi-agent deep game decision mechanism, dynamically balancing channel priorities of different types of materials by using reinforcement learning, realizing distributed conflict resolution, developing a block chain-based cross-domain scheduling instruction synchronization system, realizing low-delay path re-planning by adopting a differential updating mechanism, supporting second-level updating of a scheduling scheme under sudden road conditions, introducing on-chain evidence storage technology to ensure instruction integrity and operation tracing, and combining a key channel competition early warning model to reduce scheduling deadlock risks.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID SUPPLY CHAIN YUNNAN CO LTD

title_en: Multi-hospital-area manpower dynamic allocation decision support system based on hierarchical response mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-hospital area manpower dynamic allocation decision support system based on a hierarchical response mechanism, and integrating the hospital information system, the electronic medical records and the office automation data in real time through a multi-source data fusion module, and constructing a distributed data warehouse through standardized cleaning. In the system operation, the data acquisition layer captures the hospital area abnormal event in real time, and drives the prediction engine to output early warning after cleaning and checking. When the response threshold is reached, the decision unit automatically matches the optimal scheduling scheme and synchronizes task instructions through the mobile terminal. The execution process implements full chain tracking, dynamically updating the resource state. And performing multi-index scoring based on the dimensions of manpower efficiency, business load and the like after the fact, driving strategy library iteration and model weight adjustment, and forming a 'monitoring-predicting-decision-executing-evaluating' closed loop. The intelligent cooperation and the elastic scheduling of the manpower resources in multiple hospital areas are realized, and the response efficiency of the sudden scene and the utilization rate of the medical resources are obviously improved.
assignees: SICHUAN PROVINCIAL PEOPLES HOSPITAL SICHUAN ACAD OF MEDICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Power plant dynamic three-dimensional model construction system based on digitization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power plant dynamic three-dimensional model construction system based on digitalization, which relates to the technical field of power plant safety management and comprises a data acquisition module, a deployment optimization module, a movement track positioning module and an intelligent path planning module. According to the invention, a space alignment technology of laser radar point clouds and 4K images is adopted, geometrical deviation is eliminated, a centimeter-level three-dimensional model is constructed, multiple types of IoT sensors such as temperature and humidity and vibration are integrated, a thermodynamic diagram and a oscillogram are dynamically marked, multidimensional environment perception is realized, distributed edge nodes are deployed, 10 paths of video streams are supported to be processed in parallel, dynamic resource allocation is combined, 30 frames/second stable visualization is ensured, inference power consumption is controlled within 15 watts through a lightweight model and a low power consumption protocol, a star algorithm and a dynamic obstruction grid updating mechanism are based, a fire spreading prediction and an obstacle expansion boundary are combined, real-time path adjustment is realized, a dynamic indicator lamp and a three-level alarm system are linked, and emergency response speed is remarkably improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN PENGRUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cloud computing-based enterprise resource planning data efficient processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cloud computing, discloses an enterprise resource planning data high-efficiency processing method based on cloud computing, the method collects system data such as finance, supply chain, production management and the like through a multi-source interface module, and utilizes hierarchical fusion framework preprocessing to obtain a standardized data set. The method is input into a task decomposition model, task decomposition parameters are generated based on a block processing mechanism and a business association rule, a multi-target scheduling model with the shortest processing time length and the smallest resource occupation as targets is constructed according to the task decomposition parameters, and a dynamic allocation algorithm is adopted to output an optimal scheduling scheme. And establishing a hierarchical execution control model comprising a strategy layer, a coordination layer and an execution layer, wherein the strategy layer performs global task planning, the coordination layer performs local resource adjustment, the execution layer tracks tasks based on a load balancing algorithm, and a processing control instruction is output to realize efficient processing. The method improves the data processing efficiency and the resource utilization rate and provides support for enterprise decision.
assignees: FUZHOU DAOXUANSHAN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hometown tax payment support system, program, and hometown tax payment support method
abstract_en: To provide a hometown tax payment support system which can receive hometown tax payment after a consumption action, a program, and a hometown tax payment support method which receives the hometown tax payment after a consumption action.SOLUTION: A hometown tax payment support system executes: first processing which receives consumption contribution-related data which includes first money amount data which indicates all or a part of a money amount paid as a compensation of a consumption action, independent from the consumption action after the consumption action, from a user terminal, when defining sales of a commodity or provision of service as a provision action, and defining receipt of the commodity or the service as the consumption action; and second processing which receives user approval about reallocation of all or a part of the money amount paid as the compensation of the consumption action to contribution concerning the hometown tax payment from the user terminal, by performing an additional payment for the hometown tax payment independent from the consumption action after the consumption action.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Centralized emergency resource allocation method for satellite fault quick response
abstract_en: The invention provides a centralized emergency resource allocation method for quick response of satellite faults, and relates to the field of aerospace. The method is suitable for a centralized satellite system and is executed by a main satellite, and comprises the steps of firstly executing satellite fault quick response to recover a target observation task which is allocated to a fault satellite for the last time, screening recovery tasks in an executing state and putting the recovery tasks into an emergency task set, secondly calculating available idle time windows of each emergency task by using idle satellite resources to execute emergency task allocation based on the available idle time windows, and finally sorting the allocated task time windows according to corresponding target priorities, relieving occupation of the time windows of the executing low-priority tasks and reallocating the time windows of the executing low-priority tasks to the rest emergency tasks so as to execute low-priority target resource preemption. The satellite task planning performance and efficiency are improved through the satellite fault quick response, the available idle time window allocation mechanism and the low-priority target resource preemption mechanism.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY;CHINA ACADEMY SPACE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Dynamic planning and anomaly identification method for intelligent routing inspection path of thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic planning and anomaly identification method for an intelligent routing inspection path of a thermal power plant, which particularly relates to the technical field of thermal power plants, and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a dynamic three-dimensional risk thermodynamic diagram and an equipment health gene code; S2, multi-target dynamic path planning, S3, multi-mode data collaborative acquisition and anomaly detection, S4, anomaly root cause association and risk level judgment, S5, anomaly-driven closed loop path re-planning, and S6, execution and dynamic updating. According to the invention, through a core technical architecture of dynamic risk thermodynamic diagram-equipment health gene codes-multi-mode anomaly detection-closed loop path planning, the full-flow optimization from risk perception, path decision and anomaly handling of intelligent inspection of a thermal power plant is realized, the inspection efficiency, equipment reliability and emergency response capability are remarkably improved, meanwhile, the risks of human misjudgment and system failure are reduced, and a core technical support is provided for intelligent transformation of the thermal power plant.
assignees: LIAONING DONGKE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent flight control system for low-altitude traffic management
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent management and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent flight control system for low-altitude traffic management, which comprises a data acquisition module, a reference construction module, a coupling positioning module, a communication disaster recovery module and a path re-planning module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring gyroscopic data, gravity gradient data and atomic clock time, the reference construction module is used for acquiring initial positioning coordinates based on the gravity gradient data and a dynamic gravity anomaly map through analysis of a gravity matching positioning algorithm, the coupling positioning module is used for acquiring positioning error vectors through analysis according to the initial positioning coordinates, the gravity gradient data and environment data, the communication disaster recovery module is used for acquiring gravity positioning results according to the analysis of the initial positioning coordinates and the positioning error vectors, and the path re-planning module is used for analyzing according to a pre-stored gravity anomaly map and the gravity positioning results to acquire an optimized flight path.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA HAIYANG GONGXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Financial business process management system, method, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a financial business process management system, a method, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein a product matching module constructs a product recommendation model based on a bank access rule base, a dynamic allocation engine distributes subscription coordinators by adopting a multi-strategy rotation algorithm, a desensitization data reconciliation module supports fuzzy matching of various field combinations, a post-credit wind control platform integrates credential auditing, channel risk grading and merchant blacklist linkage functions, an examination supervision module realizes screen cutting prevention monitoring and abnormal behavior detection, an activity management unit completes closed-loop management of issuing and verifying of gold reduction, a channel assessment matrix calculates a 5-dimensional risk index containing deviation degree of branch utilization rate and estimation of reject ratio, a feed tracking system updates bank approval progress in real time and synchronizes to a business end, a data center station uniformly stores customer images, approval knowledge base and third-party credit data, and the financial business process management system in the invention greatly reduces reconciliation time.
assignees: YISHU INFORMATION TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance system of fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance system of a fire-fighting robot, and relates to the technical field of navigation and obstacle avoidance. According to the method, the accuracy and feasibility of path planning are effectively ensured by constructing the three-dimensional state unit set and eliminating the non-accessible area; the system can realize local reconstruction and continuity recovery of the path through the graph structure updating and path correcting module, and avoid delay and resource waste caused by global re-planning in the traditional system. The invention also merges the space overlap ratio calculation and jump detection method, thereby effectively improving the reliability of key frame node identification and the stability of task switching.

title_en: Real estate operation management system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based real estate operation management system, which belongs to the technical field of real estate operation management and comprises a data acquisition unit, a digital twinning modeling unit, an intelligent analysis unit, an intelligent recruiting unit, an operation monitoring center unit and a customer experience platform unit, wherein the data acquisition unit is connected with the digital twinning modeling unit, the digital twinning modeling unit is connected with the intelligent analysis unit, the intelligent analysis unit is respectively connected with the intelligent recruiting unit and the operation monitoring center unit, and the intelligent recruiting unit and the operation monitoring center unit are both connected with the customer experience platform unit. The invention realizes comprehensive mapping and dynamic optimization from physical space to virtual space, data driving, real-time simulation optimization, predictive maintenance, dynamic allocation of resources, and from design, construction to operation and maintenance, the data continuity supports the long-term management of asset value, the digital twin energy consumption optimization helps to commercially produce carbon and reduce emission by 30%, and additional benefits are created in participation in carbon transaction.
assignees: THE FOURTH ENG CO LTD OF CCCC FIRST HIGHWAY ENG CO LTD

title_en: System and method for constructing trusted secure digital storage space
abstract_en: The application discloses a system and a method for constructing a trusted secure digital storage space, which relate to the technical field of secure data storage and comprise the steps of carrying out dynamic fragment mapping on original data to generate an initial dynamic allocation key, carrying out secondary encryption on the initial dynamic allocation key to obtain a re-encryption time dynamic allocation key, carrying out authority control on data access behaviors according to user roles and a dynamically generated temporary key, carrying out hierarchical verification on encrypted data fragments, calculating a storage authentication code, carrying out dynamic redundancy storage strategy according to data sensitive types of the original data, and accelerating the calculation process of secondary encryption processing. The application constructs a comprehensive data security protection framework by systematically integrating dynamic slicing, layered encryption, dynamic access control, layered verification and self-healing disaster recovery technologies, and provides a complete and operable methodology and technical implementation which can give consideration to security and efficiency.
assignees: SICHUAN YOUJIA SUYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent agent, intelligent emergency communication scheduling method, electronic equipment and readable medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an intelligent agent, an intelligent emergency communication scheduling method, electronic equipment and a readable medium, and belongs to the technical field of communication. The intelligent agent is provided with a model corresponding to basic functions such as intention recognition, content generation, information perception, data analysis, resource scheduling, interaction management and the like, and can dynamically arrange the model to realize corresponding service functions such as preprocessing of acquired information, resource allocation and decision support, personnel scheduling and task allocation, real-time feedback and adjustment and the like. Under the emergency communication scene, the intelligent agent can automatically combine the acquired information to analyze emergency association, requirements and the like, realize dynamic allocation and real-time adjustment of the whole flow of personnel and resources, shorten the scheduling time on the basis of ensuring the accuracy and the stability, improve the scheduling efficiency under the emergency communication scene and reduce the labor cost investment.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM CORP LTD TECHNOLOGY INNOVATION CENTER;CHINA TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Mobile information asset inventory management system based on parallel chains
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile information asset inventory management system based on parallel chains, which relates to the technical field of information asset management and comprises a main chain, parallel chains, a cross-chain interaction module, a management platform, a mobile terminal and an asset tag, wherein the main chain stores asset metadata, core transaction records, a cross-chain protocol and an authority token. In the invention, the system records the core metadata, state change and core transaction log of the asset through the main chain, realizes the storage of the asset from the whole flow chain of warehousing, checking and transferring to recovery, all data are encrypted and written in a block form, the integrity and the non-tamper property of the data are ensured, a trusted basis is provided for asset supervision and audit analysis, the parallel chain adopts an authorized Bayesian fault-tolerant consensus mechanism, the processing capacity of more than 1500 transactions per second is provided, and the optimal checking task allocation scheme is generated according to seven dimensions of asset state, personnel position, task load and the like by matching with the reinforcement learning dynamic allocation module, so that the task execution efficiency is remarkably improved.
assignees: STATE GRID INNER MONGOLIA EASTERN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD POWER SUPPLY SERVICE SUPERVISION AND SUPPORT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Investment optimization measuring and calculating method, device, equipment and medium based on multi-mode artificial intelligent model
abstract_en: The application relates to an investment optimization measuring and calculating method, device, equipment and medium based on a multi-modal artificial intelligent model, wherein the method comprises the following steps of carrying out unified formatting treatment on integrated first multi-source data to form a multi-modal feature vector capable of being directly input into a pre-training model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining predicted values of a construction period, a settlement period and a resolution period of a power grid project and a monthly investment proportion sequence based on the multi-mode feature vector, adjusting the investment proportion of the remaining months in real time, reallocating annual investment limits among a plurality of power grid projects according to a fund utilization threshold based on the updated monthly investment proportion, and generating the annual investment limits, a milestone plan and a fund expenditure curve of a single power grid project according to the adjusted annual investment plan. The application enhances the prediction capability and the reliability of decision support of the model, improves the adaptability and the flexibility of investment decisions, and improves the adaptability and the flexibility of investment plans.

title_en: Multi-water source dynamic allocation system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application relates to an artificial intelligence-based multi-water source dynamic allocation system and method. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data classification module, a trend analysis module, a weight adjustment module, a scheme generation module, an effect verification module and a scheme optimization module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires equipment operation data and environment factor data of multiple water source points through a sensor network and gathers the equipment operation data and the environment factor data into water source characteristic data, the data classification module classifies the water source characteristic data by adopting a support vector machine algorithm to obtain a parameter set, the trend analysis module analyzes a variation trend of the water source characteristic data by utilizing a random forest algorithm, the weight adjustment module dynamically adjusts the parameters according to the trend to generate a weighted parameter set, the scheme generation module simulates a multiple water source collaborative scene through a pre-trained neural network model based on the weighted parameter set to generate a water resource allocation scheme, the effect verification module verifies the effect of the scheme by adopting an analog simulation method, and the scheme optimization module optimizes scheduling parameters according to verification results to obtain the optimized water resource allocation scheme. The method can realize the high-efficiency dynamic allocation of water resources and the optimization of the overall operation efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent management method, system, equipment and medium for first-aid medicines and articles
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent management method, system, equipment and medium for emergency medicines and articles. The method comprises the steps of firstly retrieving medicine production and transportation data from a blockchain, combining real-time data of storage equipment, calculating on-time delivery rate, quantity accuracy and quality qualification rate, weighting to generate supply evaluation scores, collecting vital signs of patients, combining injuries and environments to generate a primary table of medicine demands, outputting suitability scores through a random forest model, fusing the supply evaluation scores and first aid priorities to generate medicine distribution priorities, matching wounded data with medicine inventory according to the distribution priorities to generate an optimization scheme, tracking the data through a full chain, monitoring the inventory, re-planning paths when the inventory is insufficient, determining final supply paths, comparing actual data of the supply paths with dynamic demands, calculating deviation values, adjusting random forest parameters according to the deviation values, and training and optimizing to obtain matching prediction results. The method improves the efficiency and scientificity of the management of the first-aid medicines and the articles, and provides reliable resource guarantee for medical first-aid.

title_en: Multi-star task scheduling hybrid control method driven by large language model
abstract_en: A multi-star task scheduling mixed control method driven by a large language model comprises the steps of carrying out semantic analysis on natural language task instructions input by a user through the large language model, automatically generating structural scheduling parameters, heuristic scheduling algorithm control parameters and multi-objective optimization weights, and guiding dynamic allocation and resource scheduling of satellite tasks. The method is combined with a heuristic algorithm to execute multi-objective optimization calculation, and the search strategy and the convergence behavior are adjusted according to the task requirements and the constraint conditions, so that the optimization effect of the scheduling scheme is ensured. Furthermore, the method supports the user to perform semantic driven re-optimization based on natural language feedback of the initial scheduling result, realizes iterative updating of the scheduling scheme, forms a closed-loop control flow from natural language input to the optimization result and then to feedback adjustment, and combines scheduling intellectualization, controllability and multi-objective optimization performance. The method solves the problems of insufficient adaptation of the traditional method to the environment dynamic property and strong dependence of initial parameters and weights, realizes the efficient multi-star task scheduling of semantic controllable and man-machine cooperation, and is suitable for scenes such as satellite group collaborative observation, real-time task planning and the like.

title_en: File collaborative management system and method for real estate registration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a file collaborative management system and method for real estate registration, and relates to the technical field of real estate management. The system comprises a collaborative collecting unit, a collaborative task management unit, a multi-source data integration unit, a blockchain-authority collaborative security unit, a collaborative analysis decision unit, a cross-department integration unit and a cloud storage unit, wherein the method comprises the steps of collaborative collecting data, dynamic allocation and feedback tasks, multi-source data cross-check fusion, collaborative security processing, multi-dimensional analysis decision and cross-department data sharing storage. According to the invention, cross-department data intercommunication, acquisition and task real-time linkage, data integration accurate verification, safety dual protection and analysis decision multi-dimensional support are realized through multi-module cooperation, so that the file management efficiency and the data reliability are remarkably improved, and a comprehensive cooperation solution is provided for real estate registration management.

title_en: Practice guidance method and system for rapid injury detection and classification of wounded person
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical first aid, and discloses a practice guidance method and a practice guidance system for rapid injury detection and classification of wounded persons. The system comprises a multi-level vital sign monitoring grid, a wounded stage dividing module, a classification rejection analysis module, a dynamic resource allocation module and a dynamic resource allocation module, wherein the multi-level vital sign monitoring grid scans a target area according to preset initial classification parameters, acquires wounded vital sign data in real time, the wounded stage dividing module converts the data into area wounded distribution thermodynamic diagrams and divides time stages to obtain thermodynamic diagram segments and stage wounded abnormal degrees of each stage, the classification rejection analysis module acquires state data of a transfer channel, calculates classification strategy rejection degrees, and determines classification adjustment amounts of each detection time stage according to the stage wounded abnormal degrees, and the dynamic resource allocation module dynamically regulates classification resource allocation proportions of each stage according to the classification adjustment amounts. The system can realize real-time collection of vital signs of wounded, dynamic evaluation of wounded condition, flexible adjustment of classification strategy and reasonable allocation of resources, improves the detection and injury classification efficiency and accuracy, and provides effective guidance for wounded treatment in sudden public events.
assignees: The 8th Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: Dormitory dynamic allocation and management method and system based on large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dormitory dynamic allocation and management method and system based on a large model, and relates to the technical field of dormitory management, wherein the method comprises the following steps of uniformly registering and maintaining dormitory building, room and bed information to finish room source basic information management; the method comprises the steps of collecting basic information, work and rest rules, social preferences and learning behaviors of students, constructing student feature images through data preprocessing, data integration and feature extraction, comprehensively utilizing a large language model based on a transform architecture, a multi-mode AI analysis technology and a multi-target optimization algorithm based on the house source basic information and the student feature images to automatically generate a dormitory optimal allocation scheme, providing three modes of student application and dormitory adjustment, manager batch adjustment and automatic recommended dormitory adjustment, supporting adjustment of the dormitory optimal allocation scheme, and realizing dormitory management through implementation of dormitory daily management, maintenance service management, management data analysis and decision support. The method and the system are used for dynamically optimizing dormitory resource allocation and improving dormitory management efficiency.

title_en: Enterprise financial cost control and analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an enterprise financial cost control and analysis system which comprises a data acquisition layer, a data preprocessing layer, a cost calculation layer, a deviation analysis layer, a decision support layer and an early warning layer, wherein each layer sequentially realizes data stream conversion and function coordination. According to the invention, a time variable t is introduced through a dynamic unit cost formula (C  unit  (t)), and the high-frequency data acquisition of 1-10 minutes/time is combined, so that the cost accounting lag time is shortened to a minute level, the system can capture raw material unit price fluctuation and production man-hour abnormality in real time, the cost response speed is improved, an LSTM algorithm of an attention mechanism is integrated, the cost prediction error rate is reduced through dynamic allocation of characteristic weights, accurate data support is provided for an enterprise to lock a low price provider in advance, the existing enterprise system is docked, the data system is not required to be reconstructed, the implementation cost is reduced, a visual report and an executable optimization scheme are output, a power manager rapidly decides, a multi-stage early warning mechanism avoids cost runaway, and enterprise loss is reduced.
assignees: JIANGXI YICHUANG SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital internet of things water affair integrated intelligent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital Internet of things water affair integrated intelligent system which comprises a basic supporting platform, an Internet of things equipment access module, a business application platform and an intelligent management and control module. The system comprises a basic support platform, a DR-A module, a PF-PSO module, a water quality prediction model, a self-adaptive optimization dosing quantity and a medicament stock constraint correlation, wherein the basic support platform provides a distributed environment and authority control, the Internet of things module is connected with the Internet of things module in a multi-protocol mode to obtain secondary water supply monitoring data, the DR-A module is used for building a dynamic risk assessment model aiming at a non-standard container, generating a risk factor by fusing pollutant, sediment and equipment states, dynamically adjusting a path cost function weight and triggering re-planning, the PF-PSO module is used for controlling residual chlorine, embedding the water quality prediction model, building the residual chlorine attenuation correlation model by combining the pollutant states, and self-adaptively optimizing the dosing quantity and correlating the medicament stock constraint. The system adopts a five-layer architecture, embeds DR-A with GIS and PF-PSO with the Internet of things platform, realizes algorithm interaction and linkage with a business sub-platform through a data bus, eliminates isolation of the modules, forms secondary water supply closed loop control, and improves water quality guarantee and operation and maintenance efficiency.

title_en: Hierarchical entropy weight method-based method for determining priorities of functional modules of culture vessels
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for determining the priority of a function module of a culturing ship based on a hierarchical entropy weight method, which belongs to the technical field of culturing ship resource allocation, and obtains demand intensity data, use frequency data, technical complexity data and economic feasibility data by determining a scheme layer according to bait conveying and feeding data, net changing and washing data, live fish conveying data, typhoon robbery and living data, and constructing a criterion layer according to the demand intensity data, the frequency of use data, the technical complexity data and the economic feasibility data, determining the priority of the function module of the culture vessel according to the scheme layer and the criterion layer, verifying the stability of the result through sensitivity analysis, and finally carrying out dynamic resource allocation on the target culture vessel based on the priority of the function module of the culture vessel. The method solves the problem that the priority evaluation of the functional module depends on subjective experience, and provides scientific support for function selection, design and resource allocation of the culture ship.
assignees: GUANGDONG INST MODERN AGRICULTURAL EQUIPMENT;SOUTH CHINA SEA FISHERIES RES INST CHINESE ACAD FISHERY SCIENCES

title_en: Intelligent dispatching system and method for mining monorail crane
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of underground auxiliary transportation of mines, in particular to an intelligent dispatching system and method for mining monorail cranes. The system builds a unified communication positioning platform based on Wi-Fi6 wireless communication, UWB high-precision positioning, RFID identification and optical fiber looped network, combines a scheduling algorithm and a GIS visualization technology, realizes centralized scheduling of monorail cranes, integrates a vehicle-mounted terminal, auxiliary facility control, safety monitoring and a remote/unmanned module, and covers the whole flow of positioning, scheduling, control and safety. The system realizes accurate positioning (static positioning precision is less than or equal to 0.3m, dynamic precision is less than or equal to 7.3 m) of the vehicle through a multi-source data fusion engine, and combines with the ArcGIS roadway three-dimensional modeling technology to construct a full-flow intelligent scheduling system which is used for covering path planning (re-planning response is less than or equal to 1.2 s), AI video monitoring (obstacle recognition distance is more than or equal to 50 m), voice communication (forced insertion response is less than or equal to 0.3 s) and remote/unmanned driving (control instruction delay is less than or equal to 500 ms), supports seamless docking with a comprehensive mine management platform, and meets the auxiliary transportation intelligent requirement of an intelligent demonstration coal mine acceptance management method.
assignees: JINGZHOU ZICHEN COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous exploration method based on boundary detection and probability sampling fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous exploration method based on boundary detection and probability sampling fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly generating a high-quality viewpoint through a probability sampling model and providing accurate data support for path planning in an exploration stage; and finally, ensuring the robustness and task continuity of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the exploration process in a complex unknown environment through a re-planning mechanism. Aiming at the technical defects of easy local optimum, low calculation efficiency, insufficient track smoothness and the like commonly existing in the existing autonomous exploration method, the invention provides a solution suitable for an unknown environment, and can efficiently and rapidly complete space exploration tasks.
assignees: SCIENCE AND TECH BRANCH SUZHOU SUNENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-driven intelligent construction site resource dynamic scheduling system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-driven intelligent construction site resource dynamic scheduling system and a method thereof, belonging to the technical field of building construction management, wherein the system comprises a four-dimensional resource topology construction module, and a four-dimensional topology map of construction resources is constructed based on UWB and RFID technologies; the system comprises a mixed engine scheduling module, a conflict prediction network module, a virtual interaction visualization module and a virtual interaction visualization module, wherein the mixed engine scheduling module adopts a mixed integer programming engine to generate a reference scheduling scheme in an initial stage, adopts a reinforcement learning optimization engine to dynamically adjust in an execution stage, establishes a conflict prediction model based on historical data and triggers a resource reallocation mechanism, and the virtual interaction visualization module displays the scheduling scheme in a virtual reality environment and supports manual intervention.

title_en: Community resident service scheduling system and method based on grid cells
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of community service, and discloses a community resident service scheduling system based on grid cells, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a grid division and dynamic image module, an edge intelligent scheduling module, a distributed resource coordination module and a feedback and optimization module. Through intelligent technology integration such as grid cell division, edge technology, three-dimensional dynamic grid portraits and distributed scheduling, each link of community resident medical care integrated service can be covered comprehensively, the single service dimension of traditional endowment is concerned, the factors such as medical health monitoring, maintenance demand matching, resource dynamic allocation and the like are also brought into, closed-loop cooperation of medical care service is deeply realized, the scheduling result is enabled to more accurately match the personalized medical care demand of community endowment groups, and more intelligent decision support is provided for the community medical care integrated service.
assignees: AIJISI INTELLIGENT TECH ZHONGSHAN CO LTD

title_en: Power grid emergency material intelligent supply chain dynamic allocation and priority ordering method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of power grid emergency management and intelligent supply chains, in particular to a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, comprising the steps of constructing a digital twin environment model integrating geographic information, real-time traffic, inventory status and fault prediction; defining a reinforcement learning framework, wherein a state space covers stock, in-transit materials, demand urgency and traffic states, an action space comprises material allocation instructions and task priority ordering, a reward function synthesizes shortage relief, delivery timeliness and cost, and a strategy network capable of outputting optimal dynamic allocation strategies is obtained through training an intelligent agent. The invention realizes intelligent dynamic allocation and priority optimization of emergency materials, and effectively improves the emergency response efficiency and resource utilization rate of the power grid.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Glass batching data archiving management interaction method based on multi-stack dynamic allocation
abstract_en: The application provides a glass batching data archiving management interaction method based on multi-stack dynamic allocation, which relates to the technical field of glass production data management, and the method realizes the classified isolation storage and orderly archiving of calibration data and batching process parameters by integrating three functional modules of calibration management, batching flow control and report form query into a unified main interface and respectively corresponding to a special calibration stack and a dynamic stacking/unstacking mechanism of a multi-type process parameter stack; the method not only improves the real-time performance and reliability of data writing and archiving, but also actively triggers a prompt mechanism to guide user intervention in an abnormal state, and simultaneously supports efficient retrieval and export of archiving results according to multidimensional conditions, thereby remarkably enhancing the data integrity, traceability and man-machine interaction efficiency of the glass batching process.

title_en: Intracardiac branch of academic or vocational study first aid kit structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a first-aid kit structure for department of cardiology, relates to the technical field of medical first-aid, and aims to solve the problems of intelligent identification deficiency, weak self-adaptive allocation, deficiency of data tracing and poor adaptability in the prior art. The device comprises an emergency article intelligent identification module, an emergency type intelligent judgment module, an emergency article dynamic allocation module, an emergency process cooperative control module, a full process data tracing and central control module, wherein the emergency type is judged through an intelligent algorithm by identifying the article state, an article allocation scheme is planned, the cooperative operation with medical equipment is realized, the data tracing is combined to form closed loop control, and the device can be adapted to various intracardiac emergency conditions such as myocardial infarction and arrhythmia and pre-hospital, intra-hospital and transportation emergency scenes without adjusting a mechanical structure, so that the emergency response time is greatly shortened, the treatment accuracy and safety are improved, the data support is provided for an emergency quality multiplex disc, and the device is suitable for various intracardiac emergency scenes.

title_en: Multi-level task allocation and decision support system oriented to man-machine symbiosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a man-machine symbiosis-oriented multi-level task allocation and decision support system, which relates to the technical field of task strategy optimization, and comprises the following components: the invention realizes the accurate execution from strategic intention to specific operation by constructing target planning, process scheduling and specific execution of multi-level task analysis and dynamic allocation, the task analysis unit decomposes macroscopic instructions into a three-layer task system with definite targets, the resource coordination unit quantifies the influence of external emergencies and internal task chain bottlenecks on the system under the drive of the decision support module, the model prediction unit predicts the execution results of different allocation schemes based on the influence, adjusts task sequences in real time, and forms a feedback optimization mechanism for environment perception, task analysis and dynamic allocation, and the mechanism ensures that strategic thinking of users is converted into automatic operation of the machine through the system.
assignees: SHANGHAI YOUHE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time charging reservation method for electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric vehicle charging path planning, and particularly relates to a real-time charging reservation method of an electric vehicle, which comprises the steps of S0, obtaining real-time traffic road network data, running states of charging stations and power grid load information, S1, obtaining initial state information of the electric vehicle initiating a charging request, S2, constructing an optimization model aiming at minimizing comprehensive cost, S3, solving the charging station with the lowest comprehensive cost and a corresponding navigation path, and carrying out charging reservation, S4, repeatedly executing optimization and solving operation in S3 when any node in the traffic road network is reached, updating the charging reservation, S5, carrying out charging service according to latest reservation information when the charging station finally selected after dynamic optimization is reached, and integrating multidimensional real-time information, supporting dynamic path re-planning and intelligent queue insertion judgment, and realizing a real-time charging reservation mechanism of the electric vehicle with the minimum comprehensive cost of a user on the premise of meeting safety and traffic constraint.

title_en: Cross-regional power disaster emergency allocation method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power and discloses a transregional power disaster emergency allocation method and a transregional power disaster emergency allocation system based on big data analysis, and the technical scheme is characterized in that transregional multi-source data acquisition and coupling modeling, two-stage resource scheduling, toughness constraint optimization and dynamic adjustment are adopted; by constructing a multi-system cooperative model of traffic-electric power-hydrogen energy and combining two-stage resource scheduling and toughness constraint optimization, accurate pre-disaster presetting and post-disaster dynamic allocation of cross-regional emergency resources are realized, regional supply and demand are balanced, and the recovery efficiency and toughness of an electric power system under a large-scale disaster are improved.

title_en: Mapping data asset evaluation system and method based on urban development prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mapping geographic information, in particular to a mapping data asset evaluation system based on urban development prediction, which comprises an urban development trend prediction unit, a data asset dynamic definition unit, a self-adaptive value composition and influence factor analysis unit, an intelligent characteristic construction and weight dynamic allocation unit, a prospective value model construction unit and an evaluation and decision support unit. The invention establishes an evaluation system of mapping geographic information data assets with dynamic response capability and look-ahead judging function by constructing an advanced urban development trend prediction model and deeply fusing the output result to key evaluation links such as data asset identification, value composition analysis, influence factor screening, feature construction, weight distribution value model construction and the like. The system can realize full life cycle, multidimensional and high-precision evaluation of the data assets, and provides scientific and reliable value support for urban planning, modern treatment and digital economic development.
assignees: ANHUI NO 1 SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST

title_en: H3 space index-based support path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geospatial data processing, and provides a support path planning method and system based on H3 space index. The method comprises the steps of conducting grid division on a target area through an H3 space index algorithm to obtain an H3 grid cell set, mapping multi-source area data into the H3 grid cell set, conducting threat intensity quantization calculation on a plurality of grid cells through a threat influence model to obtain threat situation distribution, conducting path searching through a multi-target optimization algorithm based on the threat situation distribution by combining a starting position and a target position to obtain an optimal flight path integrating threat risks, flight distances and resource consumption, monitoring environmental changes in real time, and conducting local path re-planning on the grid cells of an affected area in the optimal flight path through incremental calculation according to an updating result of the threat situation distribution when the environmental change exceeds a preset threshold value to obtain an updated flight path. The invention improves the efficiency and the safety of path planning.
assignees: TIANJIN JINHANG INST OF COMPUTING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent planning system of medium and small-sized city intelligent traffic system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent planning system of a medium and small-sized city intelligent traffic system, which comprises a multi-source data fusion layer, a user preference dynamic modeling layer, an interaction and feedback layer, a path planning engine layer, an edge node camera, a boundary analysis layer, a boundary calculation optimization layer and an interaction and feedback layer, wherein the multi-source data fusion layer is used for constructing a traffic state base, the user preference dynamic modeling layer is used for defining a contextualization weight matrix through a Drools rule engine based on a multi-dimensional preference library, integrating user history behaviors by combining an AHP (advanced high level) analytic hierarchy process, identifying diversion point peripheral events by utilizing the edge node camera to reversely push real preferences to generate a personalized path evaluation weight matrix, capturing user implicit requirements, the path planning engine layer is used for generating candidate paths with stability scores and screening non-dominant solutions by combining with the user preference weight matrix, the edge calculation optimization layer is used for detecting events in real time, starting path re-planning immediately when the events influence trigger a traffic state change threshold, and the interaction and feedback layer is used for supporting voice/text requirement input through a user side APP, and displaying paths and marking key events and service facilities by adopting a map.

title_en: Electric power natural disaster emergency resource allocation method and system based on multi-data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power and discloses an electric power natural disaster emergency resource allocation method and system based on multi-data fusion, and the technical scheme is characterized in that multi-source data acquisition and fusion, resource demand prediction, dynamic allocation scheme generation, real-time monitoring and adjustment; by constructing a multisource data fusion system, a high-precision demand prediction model is established, an optimal allocation scheme is dynamically generated by combining traffic accessibility, accurate and efficient overall planning of emergency resources is achieved, the resource utilization rate is improved, and the power recovery time after disasters is shortened.

title_en: Urban logistics hub system based on digital twinning and use method
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twinning-based city logistics hub system and a use method thereof, relating to the technical field of intelligent logistics and industrial Internet of things, comprising a dynamic data acquisition layer, a dynamic data processing layer, a data processing layer and a data processing layer, wherein the dynamic data acquisition layer is used for acquiring multi-mode data and preprocessing the data; the collaborative optimization engine layer comprises a path planning module and a reinforcement learning module, wherein the path planning module is used for performing cross-mode path planning to generate an initial path, the reinforcement learning module is used for performing conflict detection based on a device scheduling result of the initial path, when a conflict is detected, actions are selected to perform strategy adjustment, the path planning module is called according to the action result to re-plan the path, and the digital twin model is also used for simulating the planned path to judge whether constraint conditions are met. The application improves the resource utilization rate, dynamic response efficiency and emergency processing capability of the logistics hub and supports global collaborative decision-making in a multi-mode intermodal transportation scene.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION THIRD ENGINEERING BUREAU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-job support is educated and is produced and teach integration resource matching and quality evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of education resource management, and discloses a high-job support, fertility and education fusion resource matching and quality evaluation system which comprises a multi-source growth data acquisition and blockchain evidence storage module, an infant growth evidence casting module, a school enterprise partner evidence collection and red distribution module, an evidence upside-down triggering and punishment execution module and a resource matching weight self-adaptive redistribution module. The system generates a unique identity for each supporting infant, acquires multidimensional growth data every day, uploads the growth data to store the evidence, casts the growth passing evidence of the non-expandable infant in real time according to the growth increment and the standard condition, and automatically reallocates resources according to the total accumulated effective passing evidence and the inverted hanging state. According to the invention, objective and traceable quantification of the supporting and breeding service quality is realized by combining the multi-source growth data acquisition and blockchain evidence storage module and the infant growth evidence casting module, so that subjectivity and hysteresis of traditional manual evaluation are avoided.

title_en: Multi-star collaborative observation task distributed planning method for emergency response
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency response-oriented multi-satellite collaborative observation task distributed planning method which comprises the steps of modeling a plurality of satellites as intelligent agents with autonomous decision-making capability, and realizing task broadcasting, bidding and confirmation between a task manager and an executor by adopting an improved contract network protocol. By constructing a multi-factor dynamic evaluation function, the task urgency, the observation feasibility, the resource state and the task conflict probability are comprehensively considered, and the intelligent bidding allocation of the observation subtasks is realized. The task conflict game diagram mechanism is introduced, so that the problem of multi-satellite bidding conflict is effectively solved, and the task scheduling fairness and the resource utilization rate are improved. The application has the functions of communication topology perception and local task re-planning, supports self-adaptive recovery under the condition of node failure or communication interruption, and improves the robustness of the system and the task completion rate. The application has the advantages of fast task response, high scheduling efficiency, strong distributed autonomy and the like, and is suitable for the collaborative planning requirement of the multi-star system in the emergency response.
assignees: XIAN INST OF SPACE RADIO TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method for selecting fire escape safety path in large building
abstract_en: The application provides a method for selecting a fire escape safety path in a large building, which relates to the field of dynamic path planning, and comprises the steps of constructing a building topological graph model, and abstracting a building space into a graph structure formed by nodes and edges; the method comprises the steps of dynamically calculating the danger level of each node by adopting a nonlinear attenuation model based on a fire disaster occurrence position, updating the danger level of the node along with time, adopting a danger sensing type path searching algorithm, fusing the danger level of the node with the moving cost, planning an escape path from a starting point to a safety exit, monitoring fire change in real time, triggering a path re-planning mechanism, dynamically adjusting the escape path, and evaluating the escape path through a multi-dimensional evaluation system to determine a final escape path. The technical scheme of the application realizes the dynamic planning of escape paths with faster response, higher safety and stronger adaptability, and provides reliable technical support for the evacuation of people in large-scale building fire disasters.

title_en: Customer flow prediction and resource dynamic allocation system for network site operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a customer flow prediction and resource dynamic allocation system for network site operation, which comprises a data acquisition module, a characteristic engineering module, a model training module, a characteristic importance ranking mechanism, a flow prediction module, an attribution analysis module and a resource allocation module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring five types of structured data of time, business, customers, external environments and policy driving, the characteristic engineering module classifies and marks acquired data to form a high-quality characteristic set, the model training module adopts a fusion model of gradient lifting decision tree and extreme gradient lifting, divides the training set, verification set and test set to perform model training and allocation, the characteristic importance ranking mechanism is embedded, the flow prediction module is used for inputting real-time data processed by characteristic engineering and outputting flow prediction values of the whole and sub business types in a future preset period, the attribution analysis module is used for positioning core driving factors based on characteristic importance weights to form attribution reports, and the resource allocation module is used for generating a special resource allocation scheme according to prediction results and the core driving factors. The invention provides good support for customer flow prediction and resource dynamic allocation of network operation.
assignees: IND AND COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA XUCHANG BRANCH

title_en: Mission-Based Agent Generation System for Adaptive AI Tasks
abstract_en: A system and method are disclosed for dynamically generating and orchestrating a team of AI agents in response to a high-level execution objective expressed in natural language. The system includes an agent proposal module that uses a language model to decompose the objective into specialized agent roles, each with defined input/output behavior, tool access, and optional scoring logic. An execution orchestrator coordinates agent operation across pre-processing, core, and post-processing stages, while a shared state memory stores all inputs, intermediate results, and final outputs with full traceability. A reflection module and optional human-in-the-loop interface enable review, scoring, and mission replanning based on system or user feedback. The invention supports applications such as document drafting, compliance evaluation, structured comparison, interview simulation, and educational content generation. It enables auditable, low-configuration task execution that produces high-quality outputs with minimal setup, supporting scalable refinement through transparent orchestration, reusable memory structures, and reviewer-guided feedback cycles.
